about: Engineering design questions of oil and gas field facilities with what the answer needs from the library: the norm pages ([code, PDF pages accepted]) and the values (a substring of the page, whitespace-insensitive) its requirements or calculation rest on. Every page and value was read in the library (2026-11-03); a question without values checks the pages only. Scored by tests/golden/engineering.py.
